title: PAR-134 SECTIONOBJECT indicator-color DWG CMC RGB retention
scope: Retain the generic CMC C2 RGB payload already parsed at the local SECTIONOBJECT indicator-color field
Emit the retained RGB through the existing CMC writer without changing indexed color paths
Verify local wire order, parser projection, handle alignment, copy/reset behavior, and fail-before-output validation

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA §2.11 defines the generic R2004+ CMC encoding as a reserved BS, method-packed BL, and RC optional name/book flags. It does not specify the SECTIONOBJECT class-specific field layout or semantics.

localSource.finding: The existing local SECTIONOBJECT parser reads its indicator-color field through readBoundedCmColor and the writer emits it through putCmColor. The parser previously retained only the normalized scalar; it now retains C2 RGB, and the writer emits C2 when present.
localSource.compatibility: One public data member was appended, preserving prior member offsets but changing DRW_SectionObject size. Downstream consumers must rebuild. No virtual method changed.

generatedControls.finding: Generated frames cover C0 ByLayer, C1 ByBlock, C3 ACI, C2 black RGB, and nonzero C2 RGB. The independent walker checks the CMC method/payload and following vertices; the production parser checks RGB/scalar retention and the section-settings/following-handle boundary. Copy, assignment, reset, and invalid-state refusal are covered.
generatedControls.limit: Generated codec vectors establish local consistency only. They are not producer-authored evidence for SECTIONOBJECT field semantics.

productionSummary: Append m_indicatorColorRgb with -1 absent sentinel and preserve it through copy/assignment/reset.
Capture RGB only when the existing bounded CMC read reports truecolor.
Emit C2 through the existing generic CMC writer while retaining indexed output for C0/C1/C3.
Reject invalid scalar/RGB state before writing the common entity prefix.
